title: Procedural landmark roofs require explicit structural collision
evidence: game/src/world/downtown/landmarks/kit.gd box()/commit()/col_box()/col_trimesh() source; roof-support/SOURCE_REPAIR.json; runtime verification still pending
snippet: 2026-10-28: Orchard Reach landmark Kit.box/loft/commit emit render geometry; commit's third boolean controls shadows, not collision. Structural roof support must be authored explicitly from the matching primitive faces or transforms. The rooftop-support patch is source-only until the root-owned roof_support_review physics/render tests pass; do not treat visible geometry as a landable surface or claim all distant/background roofs covered.
